harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1-node3 (RHEL7), loaded it with application data, then added node4 as a fourth member which received the full dataset via SST and accepted writes that replicated back to the original members. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol for all four nodes, one at a time with quorum preserved, verifying changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Configured MariaDB 10.11 archive yum repo and EPEL (for pv dependency) on node1-node4 (RHEL7)
Installed MariaDB-server, MariaDB-client, galera-4, MariaDB-shared on all four nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306, 4567/tcp+udp, 4568, 4444 on all four nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on node1-node3 with a 3-node gcomm cluster address and unique wsrep_node_name/address per node
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 (galera_new_cluster), then started mariadb on node2 and node3 to join via rsync SST; confirmed wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced
Enabled mariadb service on node1-node3; generated a root password on node1 and applied via ALTER USER, which replicated cluster-wide via Galera TOI
Created appdata.orders table with sample rows on node1; verified replication to node2 and node3
Updated wsrep_cluster_address on node1-node3 to include node4; wrote galera.cnf on node4 with the 4-node gcomm address
Enabled and started mariadb on node4; it joined via SST, received the full dataset, and reached wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, Primary
Distributed root credentials to node2/node3/node4 over SSH using CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY/PRIVKEY, then removed the transient copies from the antrieb home directories
Performed a write (INSERT) on node4 and confirmed it replicated back to node1, proving node4 accepts writes like the other members
Captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, wsrep status, row counts) on all four nodes
Restarted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full Galera/data resync before moving to the next node
Repeated the same restart-verify sequence for node2, node3, and node4, preserving 3-of-4 quorum throughout
Performed a final cross-cluster check confirming cluster_size=4, Primary status, and consistent replicated data on all nodes after all four restarts

evidence.requirement: Three-member Galera cluster running on node1, node2, node3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (cluster_size=1, Primary); node2 and node3 joined via SST reaching cluster_size=2 then 3, Synced; appdata.orders created on node1 with sample rows and confirmed present on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node4 added as a fourth member carrying existing data
evidence.summary: node4 configured with 4-node gcomm address, started, joined via SST, reached wsrep_cluster_size=4/Synced/Primary with the pre-existing appdata.orders rows visible

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like the other members
evidence.summary: INSERT executed directly on node4 succeeded and the new row was visible when queried from node1, proving bidirectional replication

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured on every node before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, uptime -s, wsrep_cluster_size/status, and appdata.orders row count on node1-node4 prior to any restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable mid-restart; boot_id changed from 2fc81aed to a810b618; mariadb active with cluster_size=4/Synced/Primary and row count=4 after restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; node unreachable mid-restart; boot_id changed from 325732f1 to dc4e6ed5; mariadb active with cluster_size=4/Synced and row count=4 after restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; node unreachable mid-restart; boot_id changed from fe422859 to 09d41920; mariadb active with cluster_size=4/Synced and row count=4 after restart

evidence.requirement: node4 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; node unreachable across two polls mid-restart; boot_id changed from 0d6209e2 to c795c3ad; mariadb active with cluster_size=4/Synced/Primary and row count=4 after restart

evidence.requirement: Final cluster-wide consistency check after all four restarts
evidence.summary: Queried node1 post-restart-sequence: wsrep_cluster_size=4, wsrep_cluster_status=Primary, and appdata.orders contains all rows including node4's write, confirming full recovery and data consistency
